limits: Two definitions are 'different' when their content-word overlap is below 0.5; a paraphrase can pass as the same and a different emphasis as different.
Attribute values are compared after lower-casing and stripping punctuation; 'grey' and 'gray' are different values.
Every entry is a candidate; a flashback, a nickname or a lie looks the same as drift here.
summary: 0 redefined, 0 attribute drift, 0 date drift, 0 repeated, 0 bible conflicts
